choose.when: INNER JOIN wizardn.tCodConstrVal CV ON CC.CustConsltType = CV.ConstrVal AND CV.ConstrCode IN('cCustConsltType','cCashcashType')
choose.otherwise: INNER JOIN wizardn.tCodConstrVal CV ON CC.CustConsltType = CV.ConstrVal AND CV.ConstrCode = #{pCodeType}

if.test: pOrderNo != null and pOrderNo != '' and pOrderNo.toString() != '0'

sql.if: AND ( CC.AnswrCntnts != '' AND CC.AnswrCntnts IS NOT NULL )
AND ( CC.AnswrCntnts = '' OR CC.AnswrCntnts IS NULL )

if.test: pStartDate != null and pStartDate != '' and pEndDate != null and pEndDate != ''

sql.if: AND ( CC.RegistDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND CC.RegistDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) )

mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tOprCustConslt CC INNER JOIN shopion.tStrChnl Ch ON Ch.ChnlCode = CC.ChnlCode
LEFT OUTER JOIN wizardn.tCodConstrVal CR ON CC.CustConsltReasonType = CR.ConstrVal AND CR.ConstrCode = 'cCustConsltReasonType' LEFT OUTER JOIN wizardn.tCodConstrVal CM ON CC.ConsltMediaType = CM.ConstrVal AND CM.ConstrCode = 'cConsltMediaType' LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrdProd P ON CC.ProdCode = P.ProdCode

SELECT CC.*, CV.ConstrValDesc AS CustConsltTypeName FROM shopion.tOprCustConslt CC INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM wizardn.tCodConstrVal WHERE ConstrCode = 'cCustConsltType') CV ON CC.CustConsltType = CV.ConstrVal WHERE CustConsltNo = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tOprCustConslt (CustConsltType, CustConsltReasonType, ConsltMediaType, CustId, CustName, CustEmail, CustPhoneNo, CustMobileNo, ConsltChnlCode, ConsltTitle, ConsltCntnts, ConsltDate, MngrId, MngrName, MngrEmail, AnswrTitle, AnswrCntnts, AnswrDate, OrderNo, OrderProdNo, OrderChangeNo, ProdCode, ItemCode, ItemName, DeliFeeType, DeliFee, ChnlCode, State, Remark, RegistDate, RegistId, RegistName) VALUES (#{custConsltType}, #{custConsltReasonType}, #{consltMediaType}, #{custId}, #{custName}, #{custEmail}, #{custPhoneNo}, #{custMobileNo}, #{consltChnlCode}, #{consltTitle}, #{consltCntnts}, NOW(), #{mngrId}, #{mngrName}, #{mngrEmail}, #{answrTitle}, #{answrCntnts}, #{answrDate}, #{orderNo}, #{orderProdNo}, #{orderChangeNo}, #{prodCode}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{deliFeeType}, #{deliFee}, #{chnlCode}, #{state}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{registId}, #{registName})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tOprCustConslt WHERE CustId = #{value} AND AnswrDate IS NULL

SELECT Cs.ChnlCode, Ch.ChnlName, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(),Cs.ConsltDate) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TodayConsltCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(),Cs.AnswrDate) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TodayAnswrCount, SUM(CASE WHEN Cs.AnswrDate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NoAnswrCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(),Cs.AnswrDate) > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LongDelayCount FROM shopion.tOprCustConslt Cs INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON Ch.ChnlCode = Cs.ChnlCode
INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON OP.OrderNo = Cs.OrderNo
AND Ch.SvcCode = #{pSvcCode} AND Cs.ChnlCode = #{pChnlCode} AND OP.ShopCode = #{pShopCode}
GROUP BY Cs.ChnlCode, Ch.ChnlName ORDER BY 6 DESC, 5 DESC, 3 DESC, 2
